screens.title: Character Record
screens.description: A dense character sheet with seven attribute rows, condition markers, and a compact monochrome status panel.

screens.title: Inventory
screens.description: A tightly packed item field with count/weight, selected-object description, and a small action strip.

screens.title: Barter Ledger
screens.description: Two offer columns, a visible balance/gap, and an explicit propose/withdraw state.

limitations: All metalwork, symbols, character data, item names, and barter values are original; no Fallout art, logo, or font is included.
The visual boundary is the original 1998 PC interface direction. Fallout 4 Pip-Boy and wrist-device styling are excluded.
No engine integration, gameplay logic, or measured search-demand evidence is included.

componentCapture.scope: Parent-reviewed component rendering; independent full-screen usage follows.
